### Strategic Recommendation
Company ko **Diversification** aur **Market Analysis** par focus karna chahiye taake apne **Market Share** ko badha sake aur **Competitive Advantage** haasil kar sake.
sql:
SELECT 
  p.name AS company_name, 
  SUM(ms.total_amount) AS total_revenue, 
  SUM(ms.product_quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM 
  master_sale ms
  JOIN products p ON ms.product_id = p.id
WHERE 
  ms.invoice_date >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 
  p.name
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;
